question: Does the earlier NLC Xu-An catalogued 1599 physical accession print the same Xing Yunlu v45 limit35 疾/遲 rate+捷法 glyphs as the separately scanned 1608 NCL 06273 and NLC CBM1408 v45 sources?

source.work: 邢雲路《古今律曆考》卷四十五
source.catalogued_print_label: 徐安明萬曆二十七年[1599]刊; this is a catalogue edition label, not independently authenticated imprint-date from colophon
source.known_same_physical_accession_prior_regi: 13NY NLC892-411999015732 第26冊 卷68; another fascicle of an already catalogued accession, NOT a new source-registry item
source.p14_context_notes: Original vertical column headed 三十五限, with both 疾度 and 遲度 in the same column. Adjacent 三十四限/三十六限 preserved for row-index validation. Crop is from unresized native JPX decoded RGB.

acquisition.original_image_window: p01–p22 in artifact, atlas PDF p1–p30; source-native JPX not transcribed with OCR

direct_manual_reading.p12_heading_scope: Original second table header visibly includes 太陰限行度, 疾曆行度/疾曆捷法 and 遲曆行度/遲曆捷法; do not confuse earlier first table.

target_1599_l35.ji_literal: 疾度一七五三六微九七五三三
target_1599_l35.chi_literal: 遲度〇一七四八微〇五九六七
target_1599_l35.note: The digit distinction near 疾 rate fourth place and coefficient tail is retained as a source-specific 1599 reading; not normalized to 1608 by expected arithmetic.

direct_manual_reading.control_l34_1599_ji: 疾度一七六四六微九七〇四一
direct_manual_reading.control_l36_1599_ji: 疾度一七三九六微九八五二六
direct_manual_reading.observation: 1599 labelled Xu An source visibly differs from 1608 NCL reported L35 疾 rate terminal (三 vs 二) and 疾 捷法 terminal (三 vs 〇), while the 遲 printed rate+捷法 strings concur. These are apparent original glyph differences bounded to these source pages; exact historical printing-plate ancestry is not proven. Older NLC CBM1408 p66 concurs with 1608 at reported 疾 L35; do not assume which is authorial.

adjudication.original_JI_820_operator: UNPROVEN; source phrase previously authenticated specifically says 遲, not 疾
adjudication.original_CHI_820_operator: SOURCE_LITERAL_EXISTS; full arithmetic precision/radix/carry still unresolved

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Shared layout and nearby numerals are not proof of direct copying or independent plate lineages among NLC Xu-An labelled 1599, NLC CBM1408 and NCL 06273 catalogued 1608 prints.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Physically authenticate colophons, blocks, recensions and specific manuscript/print chronology before labeling L35 original variants as independent editorial decisions.

next_priority: Independent native source operator for 疾, source-native 少/微 numerical radix and precision/carry in the same section, independently printed earlier Xu An target and plate/colophon identity; do not force G893 six target final decisions.
